meta.name: bdhs harmonized crosswalk
meta.description: Cross-round harmonization rules for BDHS recode files, derived from metadata-only codebooks of local files and validated with weighted aggregates against the DHS API.

rounds.note: No local file; rules for this round are NOT included. Expect 6 divisions and separate WI/HW files (per DHS API dataset list).

rule_methods.map: Recode source codes via `map` (string keys = source codes). Codes in `na_codes` -> NA. Any other observed code -> NA plus a warning.
rule_methods.numeric: Copy numeric; codes in `na_codes` -> NA; divide by `divide_by`; optional `valid_range` (outside -> NA).
rule_methods.range_map: Assign `level` when from <= code <= to; `na_codes` -> NA.
rule_methods.any_of: 1 if any of `vars` is in `true_codes`; 0 if at least one var is non-missing and none match; NA if all missing. `label_check` = regex each source variable label must match (guards the letter drift of m3*).
rule_methods.expr: R expression evaluated with the source variables in a data mask (`lookup` = this file's lookups).
rule_methods.derive: Computed from another harmonized variable using the variable-level `derive` block.
rule_methods.unavailable: Not available in this round; `check_var` documents the empty/absent source.
rule_methods.external_file: Lives in another recode file (WI/HW) of the same survey; join key given; not verified locally.

file_codes.KR: Children's recode (births in last 5 years; 3 years in 1993-94)

notes: Every v-variable rule written for KR applies unchanged to IR and BR of the same round (same v-section; verified for 2017-18 IR/BR and 2022 IR).
`pr_hr_equivalent` names the household-file variable; codes verified identical for 2017-18 (HR, PR) and 2022 (PR) only.
Value labels in DHS files can be wrong: see religion 1993-94, roof 1999-2000, wall 2017-18 KR/IR.
0.2.0: vacc_basic_all gets an evaluable expression; external_file rules carry an `apply` rule (map/numeric) used when the WI/HW variable has been merged into the data with bdhs_merge().

variables.name: strata
variables.label: Sampling-error strata (v022)
variables.notes: Use v022 for variance estimation. 1993-94..2007: 148/168/177/179 pseudo-strata (pairs of PSUs; 1993-94 and 2007 strata cross urban/rural). 2011: 20, 2014: 20 (v023 has 21; code 6 'rangpur city corp.' absent in v022), 2017-18: 22, 2022: 16 (division x urban/rural). variables.name: division_trend6
variables.label: Division, 6-division trend-consistent (Rangpur->Rajshahi, Mymensingh->Dhaka; 1993-94 Sylhet rebuilt from district)

BD1994DHS.note: sdistr uses BBS district geocodes (verified identical to 2022 sdist codes). Districts 36 Habiganj, 58 Maulvibazar, 90 Sunamganj, 91 Sylhet are all coded v024=2 (Chittagong) in 1993-94. 1 record has sdistr=79 (Pirojpur) with v024=5: keep v024.

This is the convention of DHS/NIPORT trend tables.
